provenance: Fixture data is invented and labeled illustrative; a measured source keeps the SOURCE REVIEW REQUIRED line. The provenance line is drawn inside the graphic.
licenses: Project MIT for the component; pinned Lucide 0.468.0 (ISC) icons and ECharts 6.0.0 (Apache-2.0) via the existing vendor manifest; no new third-party files.

checks: token-only colors and verified palette switch
no ellipsis, collision, occlusion or clipping

purpose: Parallel lanes of timed spans with an optional shared-lock region.
use_when: Show how parallel work overlaps and where a lock serializes it.
not_when: Message order without timing (use sequence); more than four lanes or four spans per lane.

parameters.lanes: 2-4 of {label <= 12, spans 1-4 of {label <= 12, start, end} ordered, non-overlapping}

limits: Axis runs from 0 to the latest end. Very short spans keep a 6 px minimum and put their label beside the bar.
